record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Bunnelby (1 star) and Diggersby (2 stars) declare EAR_DIG; both range 1, maxPP 100, no declared passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index only.
record.summary: Single-target cast: reads the ground-hole depth (0 to 5) stored for the target's cell, deals SPECIAL damage of base (30/60/120/240 by stars) plus depth x per-level (5/10/20/40 by stars), AP-scaled and SPE_DEF-reduced, then, if the cell had depth 0, digs a depth-1 hole there. The depth used for damage is the value before the dig, so a first hit on a flat cell gets no depth bonus. The hole array read and written is always the simulation's blue player's (target.simulation.bluePlayer), whichever team the target is on; if there is no blue player no hole is read or dug and depth counts as 0.

targeting.who: the cast target only; the hole state is looked up by the target's current cell
targeting.note: Index = positionY x 8 + positionX into bluePlayer.groundHoles. The array is not selected by the target's or caster's team, so a red-team target is looked up in the same blue-player array. Holes dug by other effects (Ground synergy, HYPER_DRILL, a passive that sets depth 5) share the array and raise the depth read here.

effects.scaling: requested amount = base + depth x per-level where depth is the cell's stored value read before the dig (0 if none or no blue player; the stored uint8 is documented elsewhere as capped at 5, not verified here). Then AP: x (1 + AP/100) over the whole sum (apBoost default true); the crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT). Examples at depth 0 / 5: Bunnelby 30 / 55 raw, Diggersby 60 / 110 raw.
effects.resolution: applied: then division by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF), shields and other untraced modifiers; reported takenDamage includes shield damage; minimum 1 after ceil. Blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (magicBounce reflects it unless Protective Pads). If blocked, the hole is still dug afterwards, because the dig does not depend on the damage result.

effects.target: the target's cell in the blue player's groundHoles
effects.description: After the damage, if depth was 0 and a blue player exists, the cell's depth is set to 1. No other change; deeper holes are not increased by this ability.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3 and 4 star columns are not reachable from the bare factory stars of the listed units. Whether other mechanics raise star counts was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The damage bonus depends on the depth stored for the target's cell. The strategy does not check for any holes elsewhere or the caster's position.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored mode. The hole state persists in the player's groundHoles array between casts (and, as far as the code read, this strategy neither resets nor deepens it beyond 0 to 1).
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: base 30/60 plus 5/10 per depth level (1/2 stars). Applied: x (1 + AP/100) over the sum, crit factor if the cast crit, SPE_DEF division, minimum 1; takenDamage reported by handleDamage includes shield damage. The depth used is the value before this cast's own dig.
